FAQ

Questions buyers ask

Don't see your question? Call or text 903-751-5812.

What's in a due diligence report?

Parcel details (APN, deed, legal description, dimensions), location and nearby amenities, taxes and zoning, what can be built, RV and camping rules, utilities, flood zone, wetlands, setbacks and HOA status, plus photos and maps.

Are the sellers open to offers?

Yes. Every seller on DispoDesk is ready to entertain offers. Send yours to Allison and we'll take it from there.

Who handles closing?

A title company handles earnest money and closing, and our transaction coordinator guides you through each step.

Do I still need to do my own due diligence?

Yes. Our reports are prepared for buyer review and are deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Buyers are responsible for a survey and for confirming septic, utilities and intended use with the county.

Can I see more photos or visit the land?

Contact Allison for the full photo folder and to arrange a visit to the property.
